scope: ch02 variant1 shop sell short-sword success, upward gold odometer, commit, and return roster

tools.remake: source-built Go/Ebiten under Xvfb in fd2-go-test-local
tools.comparison: ImageMagick raw RGB and compare -metric AE

oracle_sandbox.limitation: The patches skip manual battle completion only. Shop code, resources, party data, and keyboard input are unchanged; this is not an unmodified general-player postbattle trace.

normal_input: after return, Sol Enter -> item list without short sword

proven: The visible gold remains 00000000 throughout the five captured success-effect atomic frames.
The original then shows an upward odometer. Dense samples include stable 00000011 and 00000036 frames before 00000037.
The first stable returned roster preserves Sol as selection0 and displays 00000037.
Re-entering Sol after return shows leather armor and herb; the sold short sword is absent.
dynamic_findings.static_binding: docs/data/ida/fd2_shop_gold_credit_ida.txt proves 0x2d3ff commits gold before phase1..9, then the sell caller removes/recomputes before returning.
dynamic_findings.remaining_unknown: Success final restoration writes and some credit intermediate windows are shorter than the screenshot sampling interval; only directly matched atomic frames are promoted to E2.

remake_adapter.contract: timeline selects an existing production success frame without commit; credit executes the first production callback but keeps the staged unit unpublished; return executes both production callbacks and composes the stable roster.
remake_adapter.limitation: Screenshot-only typed/raw bootstrap; it does not prove native FD2.SAV or an unmodified campaign path.
